name: WorkspaceCard
srcDivergence: Deliberate, not stale — THREE substitutions, all forced, and no content difference behind them. (1) DATA: the file reads `bscBaseDir` from `useAppStore()`; the preview has no app store, so the record uses local `useState`. (2) BEHAVIOUR: the file's `chooseBaseDir` awaits `invoke("pick_directory")`, a Tauri command with no backend in the preview, so the record stubs it to a plausible sample path — and says so in its own comment. (3) COMPONENT: the file imports `SettingsTextField` from a RELATIVE `../pages/SettingsControls`, which a record may not carry, so the record composes the shared `TextField` primitive instead. Everything else — the label, placeholder, trailing Choose button and the whole hint — is the file's, character for character apart from an ASCII `...` where the file has an ellipsis. Checked line by line rather than inferred, because the component substitution changes the markup and so defeats the automatic render-layer check. Hand-reviewed for `record-src-reconcile`.
